<script>function detectDevice() {
			// Check for app user first
			if (document.querySelector("html").classList.contains("is-app-user")) {
				return {
					formSource: 'App',
					method: 'app-user-class'
				};
			}

			// 1. User-Agent Client Hints (Chromium browsers)
			let uaMobile = false;
			if (navigator.userAgentData) {
				uaMobile = navigator.userAgentData.mobile;
			}

			// 2. UA string fallback
			const ua = navigator.userAgent;
			if (!uaMobile) {
				uaMobile = /Mobi|Android|iPhone|iPod|webOS|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(ua);
			}

			// 3. Touch capability
			const hasTouch = "ontouchstart" in window || navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0;

			// 4. Viewport width
			const narrowViewport = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 768px)").matches;

			// 5. Coarse pointer (touch screens vs precise mouse)
			const coarsePointer = window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches;

			// 6. iPad detection (reports as Mac since iPadOS 13)
			const isIPad = /Macintosh/i.test(ua) && hasTouch && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1;

			// Combined score — more signals = higher confidence
			let score = 0;
			if (uaMobile) score += 2;
			if (hasTouch) score += 1;
			if (narrowViewport) score += 1;
			if (coarsePointer) score += 1;
			if (isIPad) score += 2;

			const isMobile = score >= 2;
			const isTablet = isIPad || (hasTouch && coarsePointer && !narrowViewport && !uaMobile);

			if (isMobile) {
				return {
					formSource: 'Mobile',
					method: 'combined-detection',
					confidence: Math.min(score / 5, 1)
				};
			} else if (isTablet) {
				return {
					formSource: 'Tablet',
					method: 'combined-detection',
					confidence: Math.min(score / 5, 1)
				};
			} else {
				return {
					formSource: 'Desktop',
					method: 'combined-detection',
					confidence: Math.min(score / 5, 1)
				};
			}
		}

		document.addEventListener('onFormieInit', (event) => {
			const device = detectDevice();
			const fieldFeedbackSource = document.querySelector('input[name="fields[feedbackSource]"]');
			
			// Console logging for testing
			console.log('Device Detection Result:', device);
			console.log('FormSource set to:', device.formSource);
			
			if (fieldFeedbackSource) {
				fieldFeedbackSource.value = device.formSource;
				console.log('FeedbackSource field value:', fieldFeedbackSource.value);
			} else {
				console.warn('FeedbackSource field not found');
			}
		});


		// Wait until the DOM is ready
		document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', (event) => {
			// Fetch the form we want to deal with
			let $form = document.querySelector('#fui-feedback-vufrpg');

			if($form){
					// Find the CSRF token hidden input, so we can replace it
					let $csrfInput = $form.querySelector('input[name="CRAFT_CSRF_TOKEN"]');

			// Fetch the new token for the form and replace the CSRF input with our new one
			fetch('/actions/formie/forms/refresh-tokens?form=feedback')
				.then(result => { return result.json(); })
				.then(result => { $csrfInput.outerHTML = result.csrf.input; });
			}
	
		});

				// Fetch the form we want to deal with
				let $form = document.querySelector('#fui-subscribe-bhespy');

				// Find the CSRF token hidden input, so we can replace it
				let $csrfInput = $form.querySelector('input[name="CRAFT_CSRF_TOKEN"]');

				// Fetch the new token for the form and replace the CSRF input with our new one
				fetch('/actions/formie/forms/refresh-tokens?form=subscribe')

<script>function detectDevice() {
			// Check for app user first
			if (document.querySelector("html").classList.contains("is-app-user")) {
				return {
					formSource: 'App',
					method: 'app-user-class'
				};
			}

			// 1. User-Agent Client Hints (Chromium browsers)
			let uaMobile = false;
			if (navigator.userAgentData) {
				uaMobile = navigator.userAgentData.mobile;
			}

			// 2. UA string fallback
			const ua = navigator.userAgent;
			if (!uaMobile) {
				uaMobile = /Mobi|Android|iPhone|iPod|webOS|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(ua);
			}

			// 3. Touch capability
			const hasTouch = "ontouchstart" in window || navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0;

			// 4. Viewport width
			const narrowViewport = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 768px)").matches;

			// 5. Coarse pointer (touch screens vs precise mouse)
			const coarsePointer = window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches;

			// 6. iPad detection (reports as Mac since iPadOS 13)
			const isIPad = /Macintosh/i.test(ua) && hasTouch && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1;

			// Combined score — more signals = higher confidence
			let score = 0;
			if (uaMobile) score += 2;
			if (hasTouch) score += 1;
			if (narrowViewport) score += 1;
			if (coarsePointer) score += 1;
			if (isIPad) score += 2;

			const isMobile = score >= 2;
			const isTablet = isIPad || (hasTouch && coarsePointer && !narrowViewport && !uaMobile);

			if (isMobile) {
				return {
					formSource: 'Mobile',
					method: 'combined-detection',
					confidence: Math.min(score / 5, 1)
				};
			} else if (isTablet) {
				return {
					formSource: 'Tablet',
					method: 'combined-detection',
					confidence: Math.min(score / 5, 1)
				};
			} else {
				return {
					formSource: 'Desktop',
					method: 'combined-detection',
					confidence: Math.min(score / 5, 1)
				};
			}
		}

		document.addEventListener('onFormieInit', (event) => {
			const device = detectDevice();
			const fieldFeedbackSource = document.querySelector('input[name="fields[feedbackSource]"]');
			
			// Console logging for testing
			console.log('Device Detection Result:', device);
			console.log('FormSource set to:', device.formSource);
			
			if (fieldFeedbackSource) {
				fieldFeedbackSource.value = device.formSource;
				console.log('FeedbackSource field value:', fieldFeedbackSource.value);
			} else {
				console.warn('FeedbackSource field not found');
			}
		});

			// Fetch the form we want to deal with

			if($form){

					let $csrfInput = $form.querySelector('input[name="CRAFT_CSRF_TOKEN"]');

			// Fetch the new token for the form and replace the CSRF input with our new one
			fetch('/actions/formie/forms/refresh-tokens?form=feedback')
				.then(result => { return result.json(); })
				.then(result => { $csrfInput.outerHTML = result.csrf.input; });
			}
	
		});

<script>function detectDevice() {
			// Check for app user first
			if (document.querySelector("html").classList.contains("is-app-user")) {
				return {
					formSource: 'App',
					method: 'app-user-class'
				};
			}

			// 1. User-Agent Client Hints (Chromium browsers)
			let uaMobile = false;
			if (navigator.userAgentData) {
				uaMobile = navigator.userAgentData.mobile;
			}

			// 2. UA string fallback
			const ua = navigator.userAgent;
			if (!uaMobile) {
				uaMobile = /Mobi|Android|iPhone|iPod|webOS|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(ua);
			}

			// 3. Touch capability
			const hasTouch = "ontouchstart" in window || navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0;

			// 4. Viewport width
			const narrowViewport = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 768px)").matches;

			// 5. Coarse pointer (touch screens vs precise mouse)
			const coarsePointer = window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches;

			// 6. iPad detection (reports as Mac since iPadOS 13)
			const isIPad = /Macintosh/i.test(ua) && hasTouch && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1;

			// Combined score — more signals = higher confidence
			let score = 0;
			if (uaMobile) score += 2;
			if (hasTouch) score += 1;
			if (narrowViewport) score += 1;
			if (coarsePointer) score += 1;
			if (isIPad) score += 2;

			const isMobile = score >= 2;
			const isTablet = isIPad || (hasTouch && coarsePointer && !narrowViewport && !uaMobile);

			if (isMobile) {
